svg.text: THE TABLE, KEY LENGTH 9, THEN A TURN OF WIDTH 7: THE 24 LINES
Each line reads: place of the carved letter =
place of the known letter + key value of its
slot (or key minus place, in the Beaufort form).
Lines in one slot share a key value.
Here slot 0 (R/K B/U C/K) puts one carved letter
under two known letters, or one known letter
over two carved ones: no alphabet can do that,
so this setting is dead before any algebra.
Every other move and key length is decided the
same way, by the exact decider when no slot
